C1236.title: 2021: A Landmark Year for Antitrust Enforcement Against Alibaba, Meituan, and Tencent
C1236.summary: In 2021, China's antitrust enforcement intensified significantly. Alibaba was fined 18.228 billion yuan for abusing market dominance, Meituan was fined 3.442 billion yuan for exclusive dealing practices, and Tencent and JD.com received maximum fines of 500,000 yuan for failing to declare business operator concentrations. Regulatory oversight of internet platforms continued to tighten.
